name: cheap-eyes
description: Hands bulk reading to cheap OpenRouter models and checks every quoted line against the source.
long_description: Claude gives large logs, documents and web pages to a cheap model through OpenRouter (zero-data-retention endpoints only) and gets back quotes and line references that cheap-eyes checks mechanically against the source, after masking secrets. The models are picked and tested on first use within a price cap, and a daily budget limits the spend. Needs an OpenRouter account with credits; set a spending limit on the key.

env.CHEAP_EYES_SETTINGS_UI: the extension settings in Claude Desktop

openrouter_key.title: OpenRouter key
openrouter_key.description: An OpenRouter API key (openrouter.ai → Keys). Give it a spending limit there: it is the real ceiling.

read_roots.title: Folders to read
read_roots.description: The folders cheap-eyes may read files from. URLs work without any folder.

https_proxy.title: Proxy
https_proxy.description: Only where OpenRouter refuses your network: http://host:port, with the login in it when the proxy needs one. Empty: a direct connection.

daily_budget_usd.title: Daily budget (USD)
daily_budget_usd.description: The most cheap-eyes spends per day (UTC); a job that would go over it is refused.

tools.name: eyes_run
tools.description: Run a cheap reading job over files or URLs; quotes are checked against the source

tools.name: eyes_result
tools.description: Read a job result, its check report or the source text

tools.name: eyes_stats
tools.description: Spend, budget, key status and the models in use
